summary: Frontend-only validation of RESTORED features (iteration 174) on https://edit-33.preview.emergentagent.com at 390x844 and 1920x800. PIN 1985 unlock works. Verified: (D) new header logo /logo-neo.jpg + Lab avatar_miki.jpg + Floor avatar_mohamed.jpg all load (naturalWidth>0, no broken images); (D) CyberBakeryTrio renders in BOTH Floor (default) and Lab dashboard with trio-card-miki/mohamed/bigmix, all 3 avatar images load, trio-guide modal opens, trio-guide-listen clickable, trio-guide-close closes; (C) account-btn reads 'Accedi' and opens AuthScreen overlay (auth-screen) with Sign in/Register tabs, auth-close closes it (no real registration attempted); (B) 5th nav card lab-nav-community renders community-view with Community feed section (shows 'Register to see the feed' login prompt, no crash); (A) ErrorBoundary never triggered across all Lab views (ricette, magazzino, planner, community, iot) and back to Floor, including rapid switching stress — no white screen; AutoReport produced no console errors; Regression: conferma-impastata, magazzino-manager, SmartPlanner, peripheral-setup + Maestro, docs-download present in both Lab and Floor. Zero non-401 console errors / zero pageerrors.

design_issues.screen: Community view / PIN screen / Ricette hero
issues: UI language falls back to English for several strings ('Enter the security PIN', 'Register to see the feed', 'MikiLab Recipes / Artisan recipes...') while the shell chrome is Italian — likely browser-locale-driven lang default; verify intended default is IT for the Italian UI product.

action_items: Optional: confirm default UI language (English strings appear on PIN screen, Ricette hero and Community while headers/cards are Italian).

Optional robustness: the very first tap on the PIN keypad is swallowed if pressed immediately after first paint (before hydration/handler attach). Not user-blocking (retry works) but causes flaky automation; consider rendering PinLock after mount or ignoring nothing/pre-hydration guard.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 308 lines and fine, but several unauthenticated calls return 401 on every load (auth/me style) filling the console with 'Failed to load resource: 401' — consider suppressing/handling expected 401 silently.
PinLock.press() relies on state closure only; fine, but no lockout/attempt counter for wrong PINs (informational, preview gate only).
test_credentials: App PIN 1985 (no user login tested per instructions)
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT for automation: after the PIN screen appears, wait ~3-4s before the first keypad click, otherwise the first tap is lost and the PIN never reaches 4 digits (app appears 'stuck' at 3 dots). Sequence: wait pin-key-1 -> wait 4000ms -> click 1,9,8,5 with 400ms gaps -> wait 3000ms. Restored features (logo/avatars, CyberBakeryTrio, AuthScreen modal, Community, ErrorBoundary/AutoReport) all verified working in iteration 174; only console noise is expected 401s for unauthenticated user.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial 'PIN unlock broken' observation was an automation timing artifact: clicks fired before React attached handlers, so the first digit was dropped (dots stopped at 3, no error shown). Adding a 4s settle wait after pin-lock appears makes unlock deterministic. No application defect confirmed.
